# Close a build pod's step

**Schema**: pij/procedure · **Source**: procedure.dd.json · **Sections**: 15

## Meta

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| id | PROC-pods-0002 |
| title | Close a build pod's step |
| area | pods |
| kind | runnable |
| status | current |
| owner | project-manager |
| updated | 2026-11-26 |
| summary | Before `pij pod down` closes the build pod's seats: the step's worktree holds nothing uncommitted and its branch has no open PR. Either one stopping stops the down, which closes nothing (a brake; `pij pod down &lt;pod&gt; --skip-close-procedure` goes on anyway). |
| superseded_by | — |

<a id="who-when"></a>

## Who when

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| who | `pij pod down` runs it in the caller's process; anyone may run a step by hand. |
| when | At pod down, with key pod-&lt;pod&gt;. A pod with no work-folder has nothing to check, and both steps pass. |

<a id="done-when"></a>

## Done when

The step's work is committed and its PR merged or closed, so closing the pod's seats loses nothing.
